name: Cyberpunk
description: Jaune toxique sur fond sombre — style Night City avec glitchs et distorsions
author: VibeLauncher

glitch.name: cyber-glitch
glitch.css: @keyframes cyber-glitch { 0%, 90%, 100% { transform: none; opacity: 1; } 92% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px) skewX(-1deg); opacity: 0.9; } 94% { transform: translate(2px, -1px) skewX(1deg); opacity: 0.85; } 96% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px); opacity: 0.95; } }

customCSS: body::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a12, #12081e, #180a28, #0a0a12); background-size: 400% 400%; animation: astolfo-bg-shimmer 20s ease-in-out infinite; opacity: 1 !important; }

body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(252,225,0,0.01) 2px, rgba(252,225,0,0.01) 4px); pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.logo-main h1 { animation: cyber-glitch 4s steps(1) infinite; color: #fce100 !important; }
.launch-btn { border-color: rgba(252,225,0,0.5) !important; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; letter-spacing: 3px !important; }
.page-header h2 { color: #fce100 !important; text-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(252,225,0,0.5), 2px 2px 0 rgba(255,0,60,0.2) !important; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace !important; }
.nav-btn.active { background: rgba(252,225,0,0.1) !important; border-color: rgba(252,225,0,0.4) !important; color: #fce100 !important; border-left: 2px solid #ff003c !important; }
